storm_name: Pune Monsoon Cloudburst Simulation (3-Hour Flash Flood Scenario)

steps.label: T+0m (Dry Baseline)
steps.description: Clear skies and dry roads across Pune. All road segments are within low risk (<0.25).

steps.label: T+15m (Onset of Rain)
steps.description: Light to moderate drizzle begins over Shivajinagar and Deccan. Road surfaces become wet.

steps.label: T+30m (Building Shower)
steps.description: Rain intensifies into a moderate shower. Storm drains begin filling; waterlogging risk rising.

steps.label: T+45m (Heavy Downpour)
steps.description: Heavy monsoon downpour across central Pune. Pune Station Underpass approaches critical capacity.

steps.label: T+60m (Severe Torrent)
steps.description: Severe cloudburst conditions. Pune Station Underpass is submerged; Mula-Mutha riverbanks swell.

steps.label: T+75m (Peak Cloudburst Intensity)
steps.description: Peak rainfall intensity. High and severe risk alerts triggered across low-lying underpasses and bridges.

steps.label: T+90m (Sustained Heavy Rain)
steps.description: Storm maintains intense precipitation. Safe routing actively diverts all traffic to elevated Camp bypass.

steps.label: T+105m (Storm Decaying)
steps.description: Precipitation easing slightly. Drains flowing at maximum discharge capacity.

steps.label: T+120m (Tapering Showers)
steps.description: Showers tapering off. Water begins receding on secondary roads; underpass remains blocked.

steps.label: T+135m (Light Rain)
steps.description: Residual light rain. Municipal work orders dispatched to clear debris from clogged culverts.

steps.label: T+150m (Drizzle / Drainage)
steps.description: Drizzle ending. Surface runoff draining steadily into Mula-Mutha river.

steps.label: T+165m (Clearing)
steps.description: Rain has stopped. Standing water clearing; travel advice transitions back towards Caution/Go.

steps.label: T+180m (Post-Storm Clear)
steps.description: Storm sequence complete. Roads returned to dry baseline conditions.
